description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope, or `ads:activate`] Approves a proposed ad campaign (ads:manage or ads:activate). With activate: true it also switches it on (needs ads:activate), through the normal activation checks, when its daily budget is within the owner's per-day agent ceiling. Read ads_caps_get with campaignId first to know the answer. Guardrails: flayr enforces the owner's agent ceiling (per month, per campaign, per day) on the server; you cannot raise it. Inside it the change is applied at once; above it nothing changes and the result is `approval_requested` (HTTP 202) with `approvalUrl`, the owner's one-click approval link: give it to the user, and repeat the exact same call once the owner approves (the approval covers that call once). Every call is audited (Ads > Agent activity) and the owner gets a daily digest. Pass agentName and reason; both are shown to the owner. Confirm with the user before activating.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/campaigns/{id}/approve.)

activate.description: Also switch it on. Needs ads:activate.

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; repeats with the same key do not re-run the activation.

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

name: ads_campaign_approve
title: Approve (and activate) a campaign
